rubric.statement: Construct the modified signature with DSPy’s field-order APIs so a new input is inserted before the existing input and two new outputs are placed before and after the existing output.
Assert that `sig.input_fields` and `sig.output_fields` report the exact final input and output key orders after the insertions.
Render the actual system prompt by calling `format_system_message(sig)` on a concrete adapter and print or otherwise expose the returned string.
Assert on the rendered system message text itself that the input fields appear in the new order, not just in the signature metadata.
Assert on the rendered system message text itself that the output fields appear in the new order around the original output.
